hotelbeds:145239.description: Located in Barcelona's city center on Numancia, opposite La Illa shopping center and 1. 2km from Sants train station, this bright, spacious hostel boasts unique architecture. The air-conditioned property offers 47 rooms, each with amenities for a comfortable stay, including a large terrace. Guests can enjoy a games room, TV lounge, and a charming café. Rooms accommodate 8-10 people. Guests under 18 must book a double room. Reservations for over 20 people are considered group bookings and have special conditions, including a non-refundable deposit.

hotelbeds:4357.description: This hotel is located 15 minutes from the centre of Barcelona, in the tourist area of Sant Just Desvern. The fairground, the Congress Center, and a thriving university area are all close by, making the hotel ideal for business and pleasure travelers alike. Facilities include a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe, currency exchange, lift, café, bar, TV room, an à-la-carte restaurant, Wi-Fi in public areas, and a conference room. Room and laundry services, a car park and a garage are also available.

hotelbeds:28039.description: This hostel enjoys a central location in Barcelona, only a short walk to Las Ramblas, with numerous florists, street artists and musicians. Also close by is the old harbour, which is dominated by the 68 m high Christopher Columbus statue, and the Gothic Quarter, which features the wonderful cathedral of St Eulalia, the Plaça del Rei and the Frederic Marés museum. Public transportation links are in the vicinity, and further highlights include the Parc Güell and the Picasso Museum.

hotelbeds:89700.description: This 4-star hotel is located in Montcada i Reixac, near El Punt shopping center, and surrounded by the main business and industrial areas of Barcelona. It is located just 1 minute away from the Renfe train station and 15 minutes by train from Plaça Catalunya, the main square in Barcelona city center. Its proximity to Montcada-Ripollet train station also gives easy access to the Bellaterra University Campus, the Vallés Technology Park and the Montmeló Circuit. The hotel offers 105 fully equipped rooms, a gym, an outdoor swimming pool (only on summer season) and parking with charging spots for electric cars, among other services.

hotelbeds:94294.description: This newly built hotel constitutes the ideal choice for business and leisure travellers who are looking to remain close enough to the city centre, but at the same time outside of all the stress which is associated with big cities. Sitting close to the AP7 motorway, which runs along the coast to Valencia and Andalusia, allows its guests to reach the centre of Barcelona or the sandy beach within a 20-minute drive. The venue offers a wide range of conference and business facilities, making it an attractive choice for those who are looking for a place where to stage their next meeting of corporate event. The comfortable and cosy rooms provide ideal conditions for relaxing and recuperating after a long day.

address.line: Ap7 Km 165, Area Servicio Porta De Barcelona

hotelbeds:4854.description: This city hotel boasts a convenient location in the city centre of Barcelona, between Avinguda Diagonal, one of the main streets in the city, and the Trade Fair area, in Les Corts neighbourhood. Guests will find a host of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues close to this charming property. The hotel is also next to Sants railway station, the capital's most important transport hub. The rooms have been tastefully decorated and come complete with a spacious private bathroom and complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection. Ideal for business travellers wishing to enjoy a comfortable stay in a privileged location, this establishment is also the perfect base from which to explore this wonderful city.

hotelbeds:23796.description: Escape the hustle of Barcelona at the Sercotel Sant Boi, a tastefully decorated hotel in the peaceful town of Sant Boi. Ideal for family vacations, romantic getaways, or business trips, this hotel offers a unique experience with a range of services. Located just 40 minutes from Barcelona's city center by public transport, you can enjoy the tranquility of Sant Boi while still being close to one of Spain's most vibrant cities. The hotel features a restaurant, gym, bar, cafe, sauna, and conference center. Nearby attractions include museums like the Agbar de les Aigües Science Museum and local shopping centers. Book your relaxing stay at the Sercotel Sant Boi through our official website for the best rates.

address.line: Carretera De La Santa Creu De Calafell, 101

interestPoints.name: COLONIA GÜELL  CONSTRUCCIONES MODERNISTAS DE GAUDI

hotelbeds:998471.description: Our renovated hotel has 74 comfortable rooms designed for your rest, in a relaxed and cozy atmosphere. This informal urban hotel is located in Terrassa, just 20 minutes from Barcelona, a town where an important junction of road, highway and railroad communications converge. The rooms at Hotel Terrassa Confort have air conditioning, free WiFi, satellite TV, desk, minibar, safe and private bathroom with hairdryer. A buffet breakfast is served daily in the hotel restaurant, where you can also enjoy a pleasant lunch or dinner. Our hotel also has facilities to host events and meetings, ask us about our rates! We look forward to seeing you soon!

interestPoints.name: Real Club de Golf El Prat

hotelbeds:5390.description: Apartments in the peaceful outskirts of Barcelona, well connected to the centre and the airport, only ten minutes by car, as well as some of the main attractions in the north-east of the capital such as the Camp Nou stadium, Conference Centre and Cervantes Park within easy reach, as well as the tram that connects it to the historic quarter just five minutes away on foot. With apartments that accommodate up to 4 guests, it offers facilities and services that are ideal for families, groups of friends or long stays, such as a swimming pool, sauna, gym, restaurant and parking to make car trips easy. In the apartments we offer a complete cleaning service, including change of bed linen and sheets, every 6 nights of stay. For stays of less than 6 days, or if you wish to increase the cleaning frequency, you can hire an additional service for only €20 vat included per service. Following our policy of optimizing resources and caring for the environment, we will change your towels every 3 days during your stay. If you wish, you can hire an additional towel change service for €8 vat included per change. Reception will be open from 12h to 20h every day, out of those times clients can auto check-in themselves through a kiosk.

hotelbeds:67219.description: This hotel lies in the industrial and business centre of La Pedrosa, very close to Fira de Barcelona, a convention and fair centre, in L'Hospitalet district. The centre of Barcelona is approximately 4km from the hotel and can easily be reached with public transport services located in the area. Barcelona Airport is just 12 km away from the hotel. This is a perfect hotel for business travelers or guests wishing to be close to the airport.

hotelbeds:4368.description: The Travelodge Barcelona del Vallés is a 3-star hotel located in the heart of the business area of Vallés, on the outskirts of Barcelona. The hotel is perfect for business trips or family getaways thanks to its friendly and welcoming atmosphere and 212 comfortable rooms. The hotel has its own parking, 4 meeting rooms, a bar and a restaurant with a terrace where you can enjoy delicious Mediterranean cuisine. You can also bring your pet with you for a surcharge of 20 euros per stay. At the Travelodge Barcelona del Vallés, we would love to offer you and your pet the best possible experience. Located on the outskirts of Barcelona, it is strategically located on the AP-7 motorway providing access to the centre of Barcelona in just 15 minutes by car. The hotel is located in the heart of the commercial district of Vallés, where you can visit the shopping centres and leisure areas of the neighbourhood on foot.

hotelbeds:7994.description: Sercotel Cornellá Barcelona is a renewed hotel located in Cornellá center, with good connection to Barcelona city by metro or train. Our 3-star hotel has 78 rooms that include everything you need to make you feel at home. They are soundproofed and equipped with comfortable queen size beds, flat screen TV with satellite channels, WIFI connection, air conditioning system, safe and private bathroom with amenities. You can choose among our different types of rooms according to your preferences. If you like practising sport, you can stay in shape during your trip, as we offer the possibility to use our gym that includes different machines and equipment. After a good exercise routine, you can also enjoy in the outdoor pool and relax while sunbathing.

hotelbeds:804459.description:
With a stay at easyHotel Barcelona Fira in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat (El Port), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Fira de Barcelona Montjuïc and Arenas de Barcelona.  This hotel is 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Fira Barcelona and 1.7 mi (2.8 km) from Camp Nou.
Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite.
Make yourself at home in one of the 204 air-conditioned rooms featuring LED televisions. Wireless Internet access (surcharge) keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include blackout drapes/curtains, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

address.line: Avinguda De La Granvia 22 Hospitalet De Llobregat

hotelbeds:78594.description: This hotel is located right opposite Barcelona-Estació de França train station, not too far away from the Gothic Quarter, the Colón statue, the Picasso Museum and the harbour. It is situated in the heart of the city near to a myriad of shopping and entertainment venues and is close to the zoo and Ciudadela Park. The city hotel is a simple but well maintained property which offers excellent value for money for those travelling on a budget. It comprises a total of 20 rooms and offers a lobby where lift access to the upper floors is available. The rooms are very basic but they are clean and well-kept. All rooms come equipped with an en-suite bathroom, air-conditioning and central heating.

hotelbeds:5327.description: Immerse yourself in the world of art at Pol & Grace Hotel by enjoying a unique room, where the walls capture the essence of the artists and designers who have participated in artistic residencies in our facilities, creating an atmosphere full of inspiration and originality'. Pol & Grace Hotel is located just 100 metres from Barcelona's Plaça Molina and Sant Gervasi train stations. It offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen satellite TV, free Wi-Fi and a working area with unlimited coffee and tea from 10:30 am. All rooms at Pol & Grace Hotel include a minibar, a free safe and the bathrooms are fully equipped with toiletries. The property serves a buffet breakfast with fresh, seasonal regional produce. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available daily. There is also a 24-hour reception with taxi service, tourist information and private parking. Fontana Metro Station is 600 metres away and offers direct connections to Plaza Catalunya Square, Las Ramblas and Park Güell. The property is a 2-minute walk from the famous Gracia district, where guests can find numerous shops, restaurants and bars.

hotelbeds:190972.description: Located in Sant Marti, Barcelona this holiday hotel is 600 metres from Bogatell Beach. It is also close to Sagrada Familia, Arc de Triomf and Barcelona Cathedral. A metro station can be found just a few hundred metres away connecting the hotel with the centre of Barcelona. The establishment comprises a total of 250 air-conditioned guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs and partnered with a private bathroom. All units have parquetted floors and are designed in colourful simplicity. In-room wireless Internet access is also available and it is complimentary in the public areas of the hotel. This is a non-smoking property. A restaurant is available on site and further dining options can be found down the street. The hotel has a café and an elegant lounge bar.

hotelbeds:2064.description: This elegant hotel is located at the heart of Granollers, lying just 28 km away from Barcelona. Guests will find themselves surrounded by an abundance of shops, restaurants and bars. The hotel is located just a short distance away from Granollers Centre train station, which offers ease of access to the heart of Barcelona. This modern hotel appeals to discerning business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms offer functional space and a relaxing ambience, perfectly conducive for work or relaxation. The hotel affords guests a wide range of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller to the highest level of excellence.

hotelbeds:362364.description: This hotel is the ideal accommodation for tourists travelling to the Catalan capital thanks to its proximity to the city's most popular attractions and to its excellent transport connections to the nearby cultural and leisure activities. Its facilities and comfortable and fully equipped rooms will allow you to relax after a walking around Gaudí's city and enjoy a fantastic stay in cosmopolitan Barcelona. We are located at the feet of Montjuïc, with excellent transport connections with Palau Sant Jordi, the Olympic Stadium and Camp Nou and just a 15-minute walk to Las Ramblas, the port, Plaça d’Espanya, also very close to the famous Carrer de Blai, a street famous for its tapas bars. We are also very close to Avinguda del Paral·lel, an avenue famous for its theatres and nightlife spots. It is the perfect starting point to discover the city, from Sagrada Familia to Casa Batlló.

hotelbeds:81986.description: This hotel lies just 18 km away from the culturally-rich city of Barcelona. It is just a 30 minutes' driving distance away from the golden-sand beaches of the Costa Dorada. The charming town of Mollet del Valles is located nearby, where guests will find a choice of typical bars and restaurants. The forests of the Gallecs Natural Park is located within easy access of the hotel. The old parish church of Santa Maria dels Gallecs is just a short distance away from the hotel. This charming hotel is immersed in culture and history. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, featuring soothing tones for a peaceful ambiance. The hotel offers facilities and services to meet the needs of every type of traveller.

hotelbeds:6828.description: This hotel complex is ideally located in the leisure resort of Sabadell. The complex is located close to a number of shops. Many restaurants, bars and nightclubs can be found just 2 km away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby. The hotel lies within driving distance of Barcelona, where a wealth of attractions can be found. This wonderful complex comprises tastefully-designed apartments and rooms, which come well equipped with modern amenities. The complex features a restaurant, as well as a cafe and a bar. Guests can enjoy an ample buffet-style breakfast.

hotelbeds:21841.description: This hotel is perfectly located in the commercial district of Vallés. It is situated close to the Baricentro shopping and leisure centre. The lively city centre of Barcelona can be found just 14 km away. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of a myriad of attractions and prominent points of interest. This charming hotel appeals to business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms and suites are spacious and functional. The rooms are soundproofed for added comfort. The hotel features an extensive range of business facilities and services, including function halls with advanced audio-visual systems.

hotelbeds:129796.description: This high-quality hotel is located on the key transportation crossroads of Catalonia, on the intersection between the AP-7 motorway, running from south to north, joining up with France and major Spanish cities. The business hotel is a 5-minute drive from the train station and a 20-minute drive from the city centre, the beach, the port and the trade fair grounds. El Prat de Llobregat Airport is approximately 22 km away. This air-conditioned establishment offers every comfort necessary and spacious rooms equipped with the latest technology for all kinds of business and leisure events. Each room features an en-suite bathroom and guests can make use of the WLAN Internet access and satellite TV.

hotelbeds:53558.description: This outstanding urban hotel features a quiet location in the north of Barcelona in Sarria-Sant Gervasi district. Guests will find Sants train station a short driving distance away and the popular Monastery of Pedralbes, a Gothic monastery housing collections from Barcelona City's history museum, is just 1. 5 kilometres away. Breaking the mould of classical hotel aesthetics, this luxurious property includes a choice of contemporary rooms, daringly designed and equipped with writing desks and Wi-Fi internet connection. Hotel amenities and facilities include meeting rooms for events, banquet services and an outdoor swimming pool surrounded by deck chairs, ideal to soak up the sun or just to relax. A delicious complete breakfast buffet is served for guests to kick start the day and a covered car park is also available for those arriving in their own vehicles.

hotelbeds:604785.description: The hotel is located in the Sants-Montjuïc district, just a few minutes away from Camp Nou and Sants station, and 16 minutes when travelling by car or train from Plaza Catalunya. Its location and great connection to the rest of the city make it the ideal accommodation for discovering Barcelona. Hotel Arya is a modern building with 6 floors and 2 terraces, one of them being in the penthouse with views, a cafe bar with breakfast service and free WIFI. The 61 spacious rooms at Arya are completely soundproof and offer either a double bed or 2 individual beds. Not to mention, you can choose those with views looking out onto Carretera de Sants, the atrium (indoor patio) or with a balcony looking out to Montjuïc mountain. All rooms offer free Wifi, USB plugs and a handy desk.

hotelbeds:215284.description: The BCN Urbaness Hotels Bonavista is a small 2-star hostel that offers an affordable accommodation option in the heart of Barcelona. Its attractions include free Wi-Fi and very good transport options. Our establishment has 28 bedrooms completely renovated in 2021. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The rooms have air conditioning, television and private bathroom. The hostel has connecting rooms (on request) and a 24-hour reception. L'Eixample is a planned neighborhood from the end of the 19th century that has a grid layout with wide streets, open spaces and modernist architecture. Nearby attractions include Antoni Gaudí's Casa Milà and the unfinished Sagrada Família, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites, as well as Illa de la Discòrdia and Plaça Catalunya. The Diagonal metro stop is nearby and allows quick and easy access to other places of interest in Barcelona

hotelbeds:110733.description: This hotel is located on the edge of Barcelona, a 2-minute walk from the City of Justice and a 5-minute drive from the Barcelona FC''s Camp Nou Stadium. The new facilities of Fira de Barcelona in L'Hospitalet and the Gran Via 2 shopping arcade are both in the vicinity of the venue and there are a number of important business and commercial areas within a short drive. Both an underground station and railway station are within a 10-minute walk and through them the city centre is just a 20-minute commute. This city business establishment is housed in a 5-storey modern building that consists of 46 well-appointed rooms. All of them have stylish décor with grey tones and bright finishes, and are equipped with ample work area with a writing desk and table lamp, as well as flat-screen satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. Business travellers will have the convenience of 2 modern meeting rooms.

hotelbeds:13934.description: This hotel is situated close to the city centre, in Barcelona's entertainment centre. Public transport links are located within a few paces of the hotel's entrance. Built in 2000, the hotel offers a total of 63 double rooms spread over 5 floors, of which 2 are singles and 61 are doubles. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with 24-hour reception desk and a safe. There is also a lift, a bar, a TV room, and an air-conditioned à la carte restaurant with non-smoking area, a conference room and an Internet terminal. A laundry service is also available. The stylish and comfortable rooms are fully equipped. Internet access is also available. Guests may serve themselves at the breakfast buffet. Non smoking property.

hotelbeds:23982.description: This appealing budget hotel offering good value for money is situated in Esplugues de Llobregat in the outskirts of the Catalan capital of Barcelona. It features a 24h-reception. The next metro station is just a short walk away, the centre of Barcelona is easily reachable by public transport. The international airport is about 10 km away and can be reached within 15 minutes by public transport.

hotelbeds:96215.description: The Travelodge Barcelona Cornellá Fira is a 3-star hotel with 138 rooms offering a cheerful decor and contemporary style. The hotel is adapted to the needs of people with reduced mobility and has a ramp at the entrance of the building, flat unobstructed floors and several rooms with en-suite bathrooms that have been designed to accommodate all needs. The hotel has its own parking, 4 meeting rooms and a restaurant with a welcoming atmosphere where you can enjoy Mediterranean cuisine with tasty and creative dishes. You can also bring your pet with you for a surcharge of 20 euros per stay. At the Travelodge Barcelona Cornellá Fira, we would love to offer you and your pet the best possible experience. Perfectly located for both a business trip and a family holiday with all the facilities to make your stay as easy and comfortable as possible. Situated on the outskirts of Barcelona, it is conveniently located for access to El Prat airport, a 10-minute drive away, and 250 m from the Fira Cornellá conference centre and 5. 6 km (10 minutes by car) from Fira Hospitalet. Guests can reach the centre of Barcelona in 30 minutes thanks to the many train and bus connections.

hotelbeds:95533.description: Thanks to this hotel's privileged location guests can visit the Montesquieu medieval castle that is 1. 4 km away, the ski slopes in Valle Nuria which are within 30 km of the property and some of the most picturesque towns in Spain, such as Vic, which is 20 km from the hotel. The establishment features well-appointed, spacious guestrooms with a private terrace from which guests can enjoy the impressive views over the Ter River. Guests can wine and dine at the on-site restaurant or purchase drinks at the hotel's bar/pub. Corporate travellers will be glad to know that the hotel offers meeting facilities. Guests with special needs are also welcome at this disability-friendly establishment.

hotelbeds:643.description: This city hotel enjoys a prime location close to the Ciudadela Parks in Barcelona. The hotel offers the ideal setting in this vibrant city for guests to explore the attractions it has to offer. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the renowned Las Ramblas as well as the intriguing Gothic Quarter. Shopping venues, entertainment areas and delightful dining options are just a leisurely stroll away. The hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality, comfortable accommodation and a convenient location. Guests will appreciate the bright, tastefully-decorated guest rooms which provide the perfect hideaway from the bustle of the city which lies just outside.

hotelbeds:4652.description: With a stay at Hotel Best Auto Hogar, you'll be centrally located in Barcelona, within a 5-minute drive of Plaça de Catalunya and La Rambla. This hotel is 2. 2 mi (3. 5 km) from Barceloneta Beach and 2. 5 mi (4 km) from Port de Barcelona. Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including a spa tub, a sauna, and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. Guests can catch a ride to nearby destinations on the area shuttle (surcharge). Stay in one of 153 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy Spanish cuisine at Cafe Espanol, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Buffet breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Avenida del Paralelo - 0. 1 km/0. 1 mi- Sala Apolo - 0. 2 km/0. 1 mi- Rambla del Raval - 0. 5 km/0. 3 mi- Maritime Museum - 0. 6 km/0. 4 mi- Palau Güell - 0. 7 km/0. 4 mi- La Rambla - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Gran Teatre del Liceu - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Barcelona Wax Museum - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Columbus Monument - 0. 8 km/0. 5 mi- Port Vell - 0. 9 km/0. 5 mi- Plaça Reial - 0. 9 km/0. 6 mi- Sant Antoni Market - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Boqueria Market - 1 km/0. 6 mi- Rambla de Mar - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi- Pompeu Fabra University - 1. 1 km/0. 7 mi. The preferred airport for Hotel Best Auto Hogar is Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) - 16. 6 km/10. 3 mi.

hotelbeds:17295.description: This hotel is centrally located at the heart of Barcelona, between Diagonal Avenue and Gran Via. It is beside the famous Plaza de Toros Monumental Bullring, the Auditorio concert hall and the National Theatre of Catalonia. Guests visiting this vibrant city will also find the Sagrada Familia Cathedral, 'Les Glòries' shopping centre and the Agbar Tower a few steps from the property. Numerous shops as well as restaurants, bars and nightclubs are in the hotel's immediate vicinity. The metro station is a 3-minute walk from the hotel, providing easy access to the city centre (just 2 stops). The beach is around 2 kilometres away. Guests will find a choice of classic rooms ranging from single to quadruple, ideal for those travelling with the whole family. They all come completely equipped and feature modern conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi internet connection.

hotelbeds:22958.description: This hotel is beautifully located in the region of Barcelona, just 100 metres away from the beach. A number of restaurants, bars and the marina can be found just 300 metres away. Barcelona's city centre is just a 30 minutes' driving distance away. Guests will find themselves just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from a choice of shops. The hotel is conveniently located just 40 km away from Barcelona Airport. This modern hotel enjoys a charming design. The guest rooms ooze character and style. The hotel features 7 conference rooms, for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes. Guests are invited to enjoy the delectable dishes that the hotel's restaurant has to offer.

hotelbeds:1389.description: A stylish family-run hotel in the heart of Barcelona's downtown district. OVERVIEW: Condado is the ideal choice for couples and groups looking to explore the city and see what Barcelona has to offer. The iconic Avenida Diagonal and the Diagonal Metro Station are nearby, providing excellent travel links to the rest of Barcelona. The historic tourist spots Le Pedrera and Casa Batillo, situated on Passeig de Gracia, are just a short walk away. The hotel has a 24-hour reception desk on hand as well as a car hire service. Despite its central location, the hotel is peaceful and elegant with an intimate boutique feel. THE BEST BIT: A family-run hotel with a distinct history, there's no doubt that Condado has a friendly and personal vibe. All the staff are happy to help with any questions or queries you have about the city. Situated in a residential area of Barcelona, you'll experience a home away from home while remaining within close distance of some of the city's top tourist sights. Being in such a central location, you're never too far from savouring everything this Spanish hotspot has to offer. ROOMS: There are a wide variety of rooms at Condado, offering plenty of choice to cater for all guests. Standard twin rooms (doubles on request) are available or if you fancy something extra special the superior rooms are the perfect choice. Rooms include: - Air conditioning - TV - Bathroom, complete with shower, toiletries and hairdryer - Wi-Fi. FOOD & DRINK: Condado has its own on-site restaurant, The Lounge, serving a delicious American-style breakfast buffet daily. Room service is also available at a supplement. Breakfast: Served daily in the main restaurant – 7. 00am – 11am.

hotelbeds:94673.description: The Hostel is located in the heart of Barcelona, next to the Sagrada Familia, very close to metro stations, train station, and bus routes, connecting it to all major sites of this vibrant city. This brand new hostel is ideal for young visitors. It offers the help of a friendly multilingual staff and features many amenities young people can't do without. WiFi and Bluetooth connections are available throughout the building. The on-site bar is a good place to relax with friends over a drink in a cosy atmosphere. The hotel has a terrace and a chill out lounge where guests can work or read in peace. A common kitchen is provided for everyone's use. All the bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms with lockers inside.

hotelbeds:121133.description: This comfortable hotel combines functionality and friendly service and is the ideal place for a short business trip or a relaxing holiday in the Penedes. The air-conditioned establishment welcomes its guests to well-appointed rooms where they can unwind by watching a movie, browsing the internet thanks to the WiFi internet access or just stretch and nap on the cosy bed. For the perfect start of the day one can treat him/herself to a freshly baked pastry and a strong coffee from the onsite cafe, before heading out to explore the area. There are plenty of things to do and see around the venue since it sits only one kilometre from Vilafranca del Penedès, capital of the Alt Penedès wine region and the so called “queen of Cava”. Those who are looking for some sun and sand will be just a 20-minute drive from the Vilanova i la Geltrú beach.

address.line: Trepat (Pol. Industrial el Clot de Moja), 5

hotelbeds:841887.description: Enjoy a stay in central Barcelona with us! We are a short walk from the National Art Museum of Catalonia and Fira de Barcelona Montjuïc. This hotel has 74 air-conditioned rooms with smart TVs, memory foam beds with down comforters, and free Wi-Fi. Start your day with a buffet breakfast (fee applies) and take advantage of the room service. Amenities include a lobby fireplace, parking and multilingual staff. The hotel is conveniently located near the Paral-lel metro station, Poble Espanyol, and the Sant Antoni Market. Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN) is 10. 1 miles away.

hotelbeds:423.description: This city hotel enjoys a central location in the mesmerising city of Barcelona. The hotel is situated opposite the Plaça Reial, and lies within easy access of the renowned street of Las Ramblas. Connections to the public transport network can be accessed nearby. The hotel offers the ideal base for travellers who are looking to explore the delightful sights and sounds that this enchanting city has to offer. The hotel enjoys a charming architectural style which fits in perfect harmony with the style of the Plaça Reial. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, and provide the ideal surroundings in which visitors can relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests are invited to enjoy a delicious breakfast to set them up for a long day's sightseeing.

hotelbeds:13801.description: This elegant conference hotel enjoys a prime location on the Bellaterra Campus, just 20 km from the vibrant city of Barcelona. Guests benefit from easy access to the city via nearby public transport links. Beautifully appointed guest rooms offer functional space and a relaxing ambiance, ideal for both work and leisure. A wide range of facilities and services further enhances the guest experience.

address.line: Vila Universitària Campus de la UAB, Edifici blanc, s/n

hotelbeds:98853.description: The hotel is situated in the Eixample district, near the city center and many tourist attractions. Its welcoming décor offers a familiar and pleasant ambiance with all the modern conveniences. Facilities at this hotel near Sagrada Familia include a breakfast room with a daily breakfast buffet (7:30–10:30 a. m. ), a TV room, a small meeting room (up to 12 people), and spacious on-site parking. This air-conditioned establishment also offers a 24-hour reception, elevator access, internet access, and room and laundry services. The hotel reserves the right to charge the first night's stay for bookings of more than five rooms upon receipt of the reservation. These bookings are not confirmed until the first night's charge is processed. Special conditions and supplements may apply to bookings of more than five rooms.

hotelbeds:14999.description: Petit Palace Junior formerly known as Sunotel Junior. Situated in a tranquil yet elegant neighborhood, this hotel offers an ideal base for exploring Barcelona's vibrant attractions. Conveniently located near public transport, guests can easily access the city's key areas. Foodies, shoppers, and architecture enthusiasts will find themselves within walking distance of numerous restaurants, boutiques, and iconic buildings. The hotel features 34 well-appointed guest rooms, each equipped with satellite TV, air conditioning, a desk, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can unwind on the rooftop terrace, boasting a seasonal pool, a hot tub, and stunning panoramic views of Barcelona. This hotel presents a perfect retreat for both couples and families seeking a relaxing getaway. The hotel is a mere 30-minute drive from Barcelona El Prat Airport.

hotelbeds:237600.description: Nestled in Viladecans, this charming hotel offers comfortable accommodations and a relaxed atmosphere, ideal for a peaceful getaway. Its convenient location near the train station provides easy access to downtown Barcelona, with its vibrant attractions, shopping districts, and cultural venues. The hotel is also well-connected to the Fira Gran Via 2 and the Fira de Barcelona in Plaça d'Espanya (Spain Square), both a short drive away. Each bright, exterior-facing room features modern furnishings and amenities for a pleasant stay. Guests can enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast or a cup of coffee from the 24-hour café. A modern lobby lounge, 24-hour reception, and on-site parking add to the convenience.

address.line: AVINGUDA OLOF PALME junto calle de la Tecnología, 24

hotelbeds:8272.description: Offering a convenient location in the heart of the Eixample district, just a few minutes from the popular Plaza Cataluña square, this modern urban hotel is the perfect base from which to explore all this vibrant city has to offer. Barcelona-El Prat airport is some 11 kilometres away and the Barceloneta beach is a short driving distance away. The spacious guest rooms have been designed with travellers' comfort in mind and provide a choice of modern conveniences for guests to feel right at home. Business travellers may appreciate the Wi-Fi internet connection available in all the accommodation units. As for the onsite facilities, this establishment provides a cosy café-bar where to share moments with the family or friends, parking and meeting rooms ideal for banquets or conferences.

hotelbeds:748019.description: The Leonardo Royal Hotel Barcelona Fira is an elegant and comfortable option for leisure and business travelers. It is ideally located near the Fira Barcelona Gran Via for those visiting the city for a conference or meeting; moreover, it is well connected to the rest of the city by metro. The hotel is equipped with air conditioning and heating, and guests can enjoy a wide breakfast buffet, a meal at the restaurant, or drinks at the bar. On the rooftop, the infinite swimming pool offers breathtaking views of the city.

hotelbeds:143885.description: This hotel (Actahotels Laumon) is strategically located in Barcelona, lying close to Avenida Meridiana. Guests will find themselves in a convenient setting, close to Sagrera metro station and the AVE train station. The city centre lies just a 20 minutes' journey via public transport. This wonderful, family-friendly property extends a warm welcome to guests upon arrival. The guest rooms provide a relaxing haven, in which to completely unwind in comfort at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the wealth of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore the splendour of the city. When booking more than 5 rooms, special conditions and supplements may apply.

hotelbeds:8605.description: This apartment hotel is located on Via Augusta, in an upscale residential area of Barcelona. The hotel is situated close to Muntaner Street and Diagonal Avenue, nestled amidst the commercial and financial heart of this mesmerising city. Guests will find themselves just a short distance away from the many attractions that this magical city has to offer. A myriad of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. This wonderful complex features beautifully-appointed apartments, which are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are sure to enjoy a comfortable, memorable stay at this hotel.

hotelbeds:4072.description: This upscale hotel is located in the city centre of Terrassa. The hotel lies just 18 km away from Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy driving distance of a wide range of cultural, historical and artistic attractions. A wide range of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can also be found nearby. This hotel enjoys an attractive design, welcoming visitors with warm hospitality and friendly service. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to completely relax and unwind. Guests can enjoy an energetic workout in the gym, followed by relaxation amidst the tranquillity of the surroundings. The hotel offers a conference room, as well as a restaurant and a bar.

hotelbeds:635143.description: Enjoy amenities like a seasonal outdoor pool and rooftop terrace with stunning city views. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee (8 AM - 11 AM). The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Relax in one of the 27 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. For your convenience, phones and safes are provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Niu Barcelona places you in the heart of Barcelona, a short walk from La Rambla and Boqueria Market. The hotel is conveniently located within 1 km of Barcelona Cathedral and 2. 9 km from Plaça de Catalunya.

hotelbeds:231510.description: This stylish and elegant hotel boasts a great position in a business district of the beautiful city of Barcelona. Located in l’Hospitalet de Llobregat area, the property is next to Plaza de Europa and very close to Gran Via trade fair. It is also well connected to the Plaza España with many cultural and entertainment options. For all this, this establishment is a good option when visiting the Catalan capital both for business or leisure. There are several types of accommodations at this property, all of them carefully designed to satisfy all kinds of guests either if they are travelling for business or with the whole family. Visitors will be amazed by the excellent common facilities and superb services offered, such as a state-of-the-art fitness room with a sauna and a hammam. There is also an outdoor swimming pool at a rooftop terrace with sun loungers and a pool bar.

hotelbeds:4477.description: Located in a peaceful area and very close to the AP7 highway, this hotel is just 20 minutes by car from Barcelona and 5 minutes from La Roca Village shopping outlet. Moreover, the property is situated opposite the Circuit de Catalunya and a mere 10 minutes from a golf course. Thus, this is a great option to rest and visit the area or stay on a business trip. The hotel offers a full range of leisure activities, including an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness centre, a free parking and a restaurant. With six meeting rooms, the hotel is perfect for organizing meetings and celebrations. All guest rooms and suites are beautifully appointed and boast a modern look. They include all the necessary amenities for a good night’s sleep.

hotelbeds:436600.description: Hostal Balmes Centro offers 24-hour reception, free WiFi and free luggage storage. It is located 5 minutes' walk from Barcelona's Paseo de Gracia Boulevard and from two of Gaudi's masterpieces: La Pedrera and Casa Batlo. Plaza Catalunya Square and Ramblas can be reached in 10 minutes' walk. You can choose between rooms with a private or shared bathroom with bath or shower. You can find numerous restaurants and bars with traditional tapas in the surrounding area. Our recepción desk can offer information about Car hire, bicycle rental, touristic bus and Flamenco Show. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 40 minutes' drive. Regular airport trains leave from a train station located just 550 metres away.

hotelbeds:33656.description: Strategically positioned in the town of Castelldefels, this prestigious hotel is close to the Olympic Channel and the Ànec Blau shopping centre. Leisure travellers will appreciate its proximity to the beaches of Castelldefels, Gavà and Sitges, and business travellers may get to Barcelona’s city centre very easily thanks to the convenient train and bus nearby connections. The property includes several types of guest rooms and suites, fully equipped with all the necessary amenities for a pleasant and comfortable stay. All of them are sound-proofed and boast a spacious bathroom with toiletries and a magnifying mirror. Those staying at this establishment will enjoy a relaxing and fun time, thanks to the leisure facilities available such as a ping-pong area, two fantastic swimming pools and a large chill-out terrace. Other features include a steam room and a cocktail bar.

hotelbeds:431.description: This cosy hotel is ideally located in a beautiful part of the higher area of the city, very close to the renowned Güell Park. Guests may take advantage of the numerous shopping and entertainment venues, as well as the tourist attractions, which are located within walking distance and may also easily be reached by making use of the excellent public transport network. This is a perfect place for a relaxing stay in this wonderful city. Only one dog or cat under 20 kg per room is allowed (upon request). Supplement of X night/animal and a pet deposit.

address.line: Passeig De La Mare De Deu Del Coll, 10

hotelbeds:76548.description: This hotel enjoys a central location just 350 meters from Barcelona's Plaza Universitat and a short 5-minute walk from the Ramblas. Nestled between the vibrant Sant Antoni, El Raval, and Gothic Quarter neighborhoods, it offers easy access to the city's historic center and a wealth of leisure, cultural, and dining options. This makes it the perfect base for exploring this chic and cosmopolitan city. Renovated in 2013, the hotel boasts a vintage yet modern and cozy atmosphere. Guests can enjoy the convenience of a minimarket at the reception and relax in a common room with a sofa and TV. The hotel's 42 simple yet well-equipped rooms provide everything needed for a pleasant stay. Please note that special conditions and supplements may apply for bookings of more than five rooms. Guests under 18 years old must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

hotelbeds:5370.description: This modern hotel enjoys a convenient location in Cerdanyola, surrounded by the university, the Parc Tecnològic del Vallès, and stunning natural scenery. Barcelona is a 20-minute drive away, and the Cerdanyola Del Vallès railway station is less than 2. 5 kilometers from the hotel. This elegant establishment boasts state-of-the-art facilities and a wide array of high-quality services. Guests can relax in spacious, elegant rooms appointed with comfortable furniture and top-notch amenities for a thoroughly enjoyable stay. A varied and wholesome buffet breakfast is available, and the on-site café serves delicious meals. The hotel also offers meeting facilities and an outdoor pool for refreshment on warm days. Guests arriving by car can use the outdoor parking.

hotelbeds:22957.description: This 4-star hotel is located on Barcelona's Avenida de Roma, between Montjuic fairgrounds and the commercial and business area of Avenida Diagonal, as well as a short distance from Sants Station. This wonderful hotel fits seamlessly into its surroundings and is decorated with contemporary works of art, dedicating each floor to a different artist. The hotel holds 59 rooms that exude elegance and style, and that are equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The hotel services include meeting rooms, a gym and a terrace with a bar and swimming pool.

hotelbeds:161537.description: This modern hotel is situated in the harbour of the seaside town of Mataró, 30 km from Barcelona. The train station is only 2 minutes away from the hotel, making it possible to reach the centre of Barcelona within 25 minutes. Badalona Chamber of Commerce and Badalona Museum are both within 20 minutes by car. The hotel features 105 rooms, 24-hour reception, free WIFI throughout, meeting rooms, business centre, restaurant, bar, fitness centre, spa and wellness, outdoor pool, boat hire, car hire and on-site parking. Wheelchair accessible.

hotelbeds:2063.description: Hotel Inglés is located right next to the Ramblas and Boquería market, 5 minutes’ walk from Plaça Catalunya. It offers 24-hour reception and rooms with free Wi-Fi and satellite TV. Air-conditioned rooms at the Inglés are simple and comfortable. They come with a private bathroom and some rooms have a private balcony. A breakfast is served every morning in a restaurant located next to the hotel. Staff at the hotel’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. You can also hire a car and store your luggage at the front desk. The Palau de la Música Catalana, a Modernist auditorium, is 10 minutes’ walk from the Hotel Inglés. The characterful streets of the Gothic Quarter are on the doorstep, and you can walk to the trendy Born area in around 5 minutes.

hotelbeds:8617.description: This splendid hotel enjoys a fantastic situation in Eixample, the heart of modern Barcelona, the ideal base for discovering the city and its iconic buildings on Passeig de Gràcia. Situated within a few minutes' strolls from Plaza de Catalunya, this wonderful hotel takes advantage of enchanting rooms which are very luminous, fully soundproofed, with air-conditioning and top-notch comforts. In addition there are disability-friendly rooms for guests' added convenience. Patrons may tone up at the well-equipped fitness centre and enjoy the delicious dishes in the charming ambience of the buffet-style restaurant. After a long day of sightseeing, visitors may sip a refreshing drink and catch-up with friends in the welcoming hotel bar. Guests may make use of Wi-Fi connection and laundry service, while those arriving by car may make use of the on-site parking.

hotelbeds:131686.description: Casa Lit Barcelona, strategically located for you to enjoy all that Barcelona has to offer. The ideal hotel for those who visit Barcelona in search of good vibes, cultural programmes, nightlife and gastronomic tourism. Located where the Cine Colón Cinema was originally located, this large house with high ceilings, light colours and pure light is 5 minutes from Las Ramblas, near the port and a few metres from Avenida Paralelo. Nearby, you will discover the most emblematic theatres and the city's top class restaurants. The hotel has 89 rooms, including duplex, double or triple rooms, making it an ideal accommodation for holidays or getaways with your partner or friends. It also has single rooms for those travelling on business. You can make use of the coworking area on the main floor. Start the day with a buffet breakfast in the dining room on the ground floor and in the evening enjoy the sunset on our rooftop terrace.

address.line: Carrer De L Arc Del Teatre, 58

hotelbeds:273599.description: The Centre Esplai Albergue is conveniently located near the airport, with easy access to the city center via bus and metro (a maximum 40-minute journey). This hostel features an indoor swimming pool (open during summer) and gardens, all within a modern, colorful building. Its 122 air-conditioned rooms come equipped with Wi-Fi, balconies, and modern furniture. The hostel can arrange various excursions, bicycle rentals, and guided Barcelona tours. Castelldefels beaches are just a 15-minute drive away.

hotelbeds:237182.description: This apartment complex boasts a prime setting in the old town of Manresa, an hour's drive from Barcelona. The complex lies just 100 metres away from the Town Hall and the Cave of Saint Ignasi. Boasting spectacular views over Montserrat, the complex offers visitors the ideal setting from which to explore this mesmerising city. The apartments occupy a listed, 18th-century building. Designed with a Baroque touch, the apartments ooze rustic elegance and splendour. The apartments offer modern amenities to ensure that each and every guest enjoyed the utmost in comfort and convenience. This complex offers visitors a comfortable, relaxing home away from home near Barcelona.

hotelbeds:475.description: This hotel is situated in the centre of Barcelona, at a pedestrian street, surrounded by monuments and the most famous and exclusive shops in Barcelona. Dating back to the 19th century and converted to a hotel in 1917, this building retains many of its original features such as ornate ceilings, lamps of cast bronze and crystal, marble floors and colour schemes immortalised by Roca-Sastre. Various shopping facilities, bars and restaurants and public transportation links are within a few minutes' walk from the hotel.

hotelbeds:130063.description: This hotel is located in the Barcelona Eixample, a residential and business area of the city, where guests can find restaurants, cafés, shops and boutiques. Nearby guests will find some of the best architectural offers like the Sagrada Família, the Monumental bullring, the Ciutadella Park, the Arc de Triomf square, Teatre Nacional de Catalunya, the auditorium, and the innovative Agbar Tower. With the nearby public transportation, guests can reach the whole city within minutes.

hotelbeds:89400.description: Located in the heart of Sant Joan Despi, this hotel is near Barcelona's main access roads and close to Cornellá Exhibition Centre, Fira Gran Via 2 Exhibition Centre in Hospitalet, and the Catalunya Congress Centre. The hotel provides a breakfast buffet, café-restaurant, TV room, business centre, external laundry service and car park. The hotel offers Wi-Fi in all guest rooms.

interestPoints.name: La Masía Ciudad Deportiva Joan Gamper (FC Barcelona)

hotelbeds:97154.description:
Hotel SB Diagonal Zero Barcelona is opposite Barcelona’s International Convention Center and Barcelona's Forum Auditorium. It has a spa, a gym, a seasonal panoramic pool and a solarium on the hotel rooftop. 

There is free access to the hotel gym. The spa is only for guests over 14 years old, and includes a Turkish bath and Finnish sauna. Beauty and massage treatments are available at a surcharge. 

All air-conditioned rooms at the Hotel SB Diagonal Zero Barcelona have flat-screen satellite TV, free WiFi and a laptop safe. The soundproofed rooms have facilities to connect iPods. 

All rooms have ironing facilities, tea and coffee making facilities, and a kettle. There is a touch-screen control for lights and temperature. The private bathroom is equipped with a hairdryer, and bathrobes and slippers can be provided upon request.

address.line: Plaza De Llevant (Esquina Rambla Prim), SN

hotelbeds:66750.description: These apartments enjoy a popular central location in the Eixample quarter, halfway between the Plaza Catalunya and the Sagrada Familia. Guests will find themselves in the heart of Barcelona, where various restaurants, shops, cinemas and supermarkets are all within easy reach. In addition, it is close to the underground station and bus stops with connections to places of interest in the city. Opened in the summer of 2006, the property includes a lobby and a lift. The apartments provide all the comforts of home with quality facilities, ideal for long or short stays of a private and business nature. They are all soundproofed and feature a coffee/tea maker and air conditioning as standard.

hotelbeds:83693.description: Boasting a truly fantastic location in the heart of Barcelona, between Plaza Catalunya and Gaudí's world famous creation La Sagrada Familia, this fantastic complex offers a first-class two-in-one accommodation. On the one hand – all the services and the comfort of a hotel, on the other – the amenities of a fully equipped apartment, and all that paired with the close proximity of various restaurants, bars, shops, supermarkets and so on. Available for both short- and long-term stays, the suites can accommodate up to five people and come with fully-equipped kitchens, where guests can prepare food to their own liking. A laundry service is provided for those who want to leave the more boring chores at home, and enjoy the flavour of Barcelona without care.

hotelbeds:117134.description: Conveniently situated in Barcelona's Eixample District, this stylish modern hotel is an ideal choice both for business trips or leisure stays as many of the major attractions are within walking distance. Opposite the National Theatre of Catalunya, it is just a short stroll from La Monumental bullring, @22 district, Sagrada Familia, Port Olímpic, Plaça de Catalunya or the old town Barri Gòtic.

hotelbeds:640.description: This appealing hotel is conveniently located in Barcelona's downtown close the commercial and business district and within a short stroll of the Avenida Diagonal, where visitors can find many shops, restaurants and other entertainment venues. The establishment is well-connected by public transport and Barcelona's airport is about a 15-minute drive away. After spending the day exploring the city, guests might rest in the elegant rooms which are equipped with high quality amenities and carefully decorated to provide a relaxing atmosphere. Visitors can enjoy modern and excellent Mediterranean cuisine in the on-site restaurant and relax with a refreshing drink in the stylish Bar. For breakfast, a rich buffet is served every morning including gluten-free products. There are various meeting rooms available for business travellers as well as free Wi-Fi throughout the building for those with laptops.

hotelbeds:4092.description: This classic city hotel enjoys a fabulous setting in the heart of Barcelona, just a stone's throw from the famous La Boqueria market and a three-minute walk from the city's most celebrated promenade, La Rambla.   Liceu metro station is 250 metres away, providing easy access to other parts of the city such as Montjuic and Gaudís stunning Parc Guell.   Set in a building dating back to 1866, this cosy, family-run hotel combines modern interior design with beautiful historic details. It features a rooftop terrace with a seasonal swimming pool, enjoying great views over the city and a 24-hour reception for added convenience.   Guests might also make use of the Wi-Fi internet connection offered throughout the hotel and wake up to a daily breakfast with both hot and cold options.

hotelbeds:94962.description: The Barceló Raval****, a cosmopolitan hotel in Barcelona's vibrant Raval district, is just a short walk from iconic landmarks like Las Ramblas, Plaza Catalunya, and the Boqueria market. This urban oasis offers 182 comfortable rooms and 4 suites, each featuring stunning city views, iPhone docking stations, and free Wi-Fi. Guests can also enjoy the innovative lobby and a panoramic 360° terrace showcasing Barcelona's skyline. The hotel is easily accessible by metro and bus, with excellent connections throughout the city. Enhanced hygiene protocols are in place to ensure guest safety and well-being.

hotelbeds:816141.description: Located in Barcelona (La Vila Olimpica del Poblenou), Unite Hostel Barcelona is within a 10-minute walk of Casino Barcelona and Port Olimpic. This hostel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Bogatell Beach and 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from Barceloneta Beach. Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as a reception hall. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and laundry facilities. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli serving guests of Unite Hostel Barcelona. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless Internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms with showers are provided.

hotelbeds:448961.description: Located between the sea and the mountains, with a superb balcony position overlooking the Mediterranean sea. Character and originality, together with an enviable hotel location, make for an unforgettable experience you will want to repeat. 33 spacious, quiet and modern rooms, including two suites with jacuzzi, all with minibar, coffee capsules, bathrobes and free Wi-Fi. Perfect for relaxing after daytime activities and night time fun. Just 30 minutes from the airport of Barcelona - El Prat and 45 minutes from Gerona airport. Very well connected by the motorway C-32 (at only 500 meters from exit 92), by bus with direct connection to the Barcelona city center (stop just opposite from the hotel) and 3 km from the train station. Outdoor swimming pool, restaurant, café with a large outdoor terrace and playground, Sorli Sports Sports Centre with paddle tennis courts and Spa where you can enjoy a relaxing and sensory experience with the team of specialists from Natura Bissé. And 2 meeting rooms, equipped with projector, screen and audio with the latest technology equipment for all kinds of events.

interestPoints.name: Museo de la Estampacion de Premiá de Mar

hotelbeds:1160.description: This fabulous hotel reveals itself within a well-manicured garden, offering a perfect place to stay while visiting Cordoba. The property enjoys an idyllic setting and is well-connected to the downtown and major city attractions such as the imposing Mosque–Cathedral of Córdoba and the Palace of Mercy, which might be reached by means of public transport. This fashionable establishment enjoys a beautiful Colonial style in architecture and décor, together with outstanding service offering a perfect base for a relaxing stopover. The guests' accommodations comprise rooms and suites. Each of them offers large and delightfully decorated surroundings complemented with cutting-edge amenities. Food lovers may delight in enticing Andalusian specialties in the in-house restaurant. Those who wish to become fit can take advantage of the fitness centre and have a soothing dip in the outdoor pool. There is a parking and an inviting bar for guests' added convenience.

hotelbeds:1612.description: 'Overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, this contemporary hotel in Barcelona's Front Marítim district is steps from Mar Bella Beach and a short walk from the Forum Barcelona venue. The city center, with attractions like Plaça de Catalunya and Passeig de Gràcia, is easily accessible by metro. Barcelona El Prat Airport is a 25-minute drive away. The hotel's 115 bright guest rooms offer relaxing sea views, ensuring a pleasant stay. Each room features amenities such as heating and air conditioning, comfortable beds, a safe, minibar, satellite TV, high-speed internet and Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, and toiletries. Guests can also enjoy delicious Mediterranean cuisine made with fresh, local ingredients at the hotel's restaurant. '

hotelbeds:7668.description: The Occidental Atenea Mar, an adults-only hotel, enjoys a prime beachfront location beside Barcelona's International Convention Centre (CCIB), the zoo, and the Diagonal Mar shopping centre with over 150 shops. This modern hotel offers easy access to various city attractions, with the metro station a mere 10 minutes away and the international airport only 20 minutes away. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel sits just 150 meters from Nova Mar Bella beach and a short walk from the CCIB and Diagonal Mar. A bus stop is conveniently located opposite the hotel, while a nearby metro station connects guests to the city's main attractions. The hotel's 191 spacious, modern rooms are all outward-facing and bright, offering views of either the sea or the city. Each room features complimentary Wi-Fi and luxurious amenities. Additional services include paid parking, a free fitness studio, a sauna, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property.

hotelbeds:1047.description: This business aparthotel is superbly nestled in vibrant shopping and business area of Diagonal Avenue. The complex is within walking distance from a number of bars, restaurants and cafes of local character. Public transport network is also within easy reach. This is the perfect location for those business travelers who need a centric location and a hotel which offers everything needed for this type of journey.

hotelbeds:2056.description: Located on Barcelona's famed Las Ramblas, this aparthotel sits in the heart of the Gothic Quarter, the oldest part of the city. Explore the traces of Barcelona's Roman past, wander the maze of medieval streets, and relax in the Plaça Reial. Corporate offices like H&M, Diesel Iberia, and Citigroup are within walking distance, as are attractions such as the Poliorama Theater and Palau Moja. Just a 4-minute walk from bustling Catalonia Square and the Placa de Catalunya station, this complex offers convenience and access to transport. The 131 apartments were fully refurbished in 2015 and feature fully equipped kitchens, TVs with satellite channels, and free high-speed internet access. The 24-hour reception adds to the convenience. Ascott Cares commitments ensure high hygiene and cleanliness standards for your safety and comfort.

hotelbeds:165031.description:
In the very heart of Barcelona, Andante Drassanes Hotel invites you to enjoy a stay that is comfortable, practical and thoughtfully designed. 
Designed for travellers who want to unwind without stepping away from city life, it combines bright spaces, practical services and a calm atmosphere just a few steps from La Rambla and the harbour. It features 134 rooms of different types, all equipped with a television and a full bathroom with a hairdryer, designed to offer comfort and well-being. 
True to the philosophy of the Andante Hotels group, Andante Drassanes reflects a genuine commitment to sustainability and conscious hospitality, incorporating efficient materials and responsible processes. Our vision is to offer high-quality services with a personal touch, maintaining a balance between comfort and sustainability. Our goal is to establish ourselves as a benchmark for responsible tourism in Barcelona. 
Our values — commitment, respect, teamwork and customer focus — are the foundation of an authentic and human experience. 
Here, comfort moves to its own rhythm: yours. 
Located just a few steps from Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter and Port Vell, Andante Drassanes Hotel places the city within easy walking distance. 
Well-connected to the airport and cruise terminal, and close to the World Trade Center, it combines convenience and connectivity in a calm, central setting. 
The perfect starting point for experiencing Barcelona at your own pace.

hotelbeds:112532.description: The establishment offers all kinds of surprises, from Mozarabic architecture to the latest trends in digital art, to its excellent location. Sitting in the city centre, its guests are a short walk away from the Gran Teatre del Liceu, Las Ramblas and the districts of Gòtic and Born. Those who are interested in exploring the architecture and the art scene will be in the immediate vicinity of the Cathedral, Palau Güell and the two most important museums: the Picasso and MACBA. The greatly preserved 19th century of the faced blends perfectly with its stylish interior. The public areas are designed to create a relaxing ambience similar to an art gallery. While the comfortable and modern rooms are equipped with top of the line amenities and are perfect places for relaxing after a long day of sightseeingParking (surcharge) under availability at check-inBreakfast is €14 per person and per day

hotelbeds:188236.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in Barcelona, lying close to the Camp Nou football stadium. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to the intriguing attractions that this artistic city has to offer. The hotel is located just 20 metres away from the Collblanc Metro Station, providing ease of access to other areas of the city. The hotel is conveniently situated just 10 km from Barcelona Airport. This delightful hotel enjoys a charming architectural style, blending effortlessly with its striking surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, providing an oasis of peace and serenity in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day. Guests are sure to appreciate the wide range of excellent facilities that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

hotelbeds:141605.description: This modern and stylish hotel housed in an old printing-press building, is nestled in L'Eixample very close to the renowned architectonic master piece of La Sagrada Familia. The city centre can easily be reached with the public transport service or the underground, which is located in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Within the area, guests will be able to find a wide range of cafes, restaurants, boutiques and shops. This is a perfect hotel from where to begin discovering the city.

hotelbeds:200075.description: Enjoying a great location in the heart of Sabadell's commercial and business district, this charming hotel offers comfortable accommodation and exceptional services to business and leisure travellers alike. This welcoming property is situated within walking distance from Plaça Catalunya, where travellers can find the main railway station as well as many entertainment options. Barcelona city is just 17 km away, while the airport is easily reachable within a 30-minute drive away. The accommodation units range from standard rooms to more luxurious suites and offer all kinds of comforts to make guests' stay as enjoyable as possible. Those travelling on business purposes may take advantage of the excellent meeting facilities and state-of-the-art equipment. The on-site restaurant invites travellers to sample simple, but exquisite homemade cuisine, and the friendly staff will be more than happy to assist guests in all their needs. Mínimum check in age 20 years. Children under 20 years old can only stay accompanied by parents.

hotelbeds:2111.description: The hotel is located in the heart of Barcelona, in the Eixample district, just a few minutes from the Ramblas, just behind the large Teatro del Liceu and the Boqueria Market. It features modern and innovative decoration. The hotel has excellent connections to the Airport and is within walking distance from the Port of Barcelona. Guests may enjoy and live Barcelona in all its essence!

hotelbeds:5084.description: This charming hotel, conveniently located just 15 km from Barcelona's El Prat Airport, offers an ideal base for exploring the city's captivating attractions. Guests enjoy easy access to Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter, and La Sagrada Familia. The tastefully appointed rooms feature modern amenities for a comfortable stay. Start your day with a delightful breakfast at the hotel. Special conditions and supplements may apply for bookings exceeding five rooms.

hotelbeds:188753.description: Located at just a 15-minute stroll from Gaudí's Sagrada Família Basilica and 5 minutes from the arc de triomf subway station, this hotel offers the perfect hub for all visitors of this lovely city. The Ciutadella park and the posh Born district are both within a 10-minute walk, add 10 more minutes and guests can get to Barcelona's' beating heart - Las Ramblas and the Barceloneta Beach. Airport connections, national and international bus services can be found in the Estació del Nord Bus Station, which is located at just 200 metres. The apartments themselves offer a bright and stylish minimalist décor, spacious common areas with flat-screen satellite TV and fully equipped kitchenettes, perfect for all self-catering types. The large windows offer a magnificent view of city sky-line. *parking available on site ( need to reserve at the time of contacting us for check in)

hotelbeds:167462.description: Situated in Barcelona's vibrant Diagonal Mar district, near the CCIB congress center and Diagonal Mar shopping center, the Vincci Bit Hotel offers a unique blend of modern art and comfortable accommodations. Each floor showcases stunning graffiti murals by nationally and internationally acclaimed illustrators and designers. The hotel's 177 bright rooms provide excellent amenities. Guests can enjoy market-fresh cuisine with local influences at the Hopen restaurant, featuring cozy indoor seating in winter and an open-air terrace during summer. A rooftop pool, sun loungers, a small gym, and a sauna are also available for guests to relax and rejuvenate. *Pool open during the summer.

hotelbeds:112531.description: At Hotel Onix Fira, a comprehensive renovation has transformed all facilities, from the rooms to the common areas, resulting in a contemporary and avant-garde design that combines comfort, functionality, and style. This three-star hotel boasts a privileged location overlooking Parc Joan Miró and adjacent to Plaça Espanya. It's perfectly situated near major business venues, including the Palau de Congressos and Fira II de Barcelona, and offers excellent connections to the airport and the Fira Exhibition Centre. All spacious, bright rooms have been renovated with a modern and functional design, featuring a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi, a safe, a minibar, and a telephone. Guests can enjoy a seasonal rooftop swimming pool with unique city views and relax or work in the modern and cozy common areas. Discover our new gastronomic spot at the Hotel, El Quiosco: you can savour traditional tapas.

hotelbeds:60199.description: Located next to Spain Square, Fira de Barcelona, and the Arenas Shopping Center, the four-star Hotel Pestana Arena Barcelona is a modern boutique hotel offering comfort and well-being. Ideal for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel is within walking distance of Sants train station and the airport shuttle service. The 84 guest rooms include eight junior suites and three executive rooms with terraces and outdoor Jacuzzis. All rooms feature air conditioning, minibars, free safes, hair dryers, 40' LCD TVs, and free Wi-Fi. A newly refurbished bar and lounge with an open terrace provides the perfect entertainment area. Guests also enjoy complimentary access to the sauna, steam room, and a small executive gym.

hotelbeds:5425.description: NH Barcelona Eixample, formerly known as NH Máster, is set in the residential Eixample district. The lively Passeig de Gracia with designer shops and trendy restaurants is only a 15-minute walk away, as are Gaudi's famous Casa Batlló and Casa Milà. Close to the Hospital Clínic metro stop, guests have direct links to the Sagrada Familia Church, Plaza España and the Fira de Barcelona exhibition center. The Sants train station is only two stops away, with direct access to the airport and city surrounding areas. NH Barcelona Eixample has 81 modern soundproof rooms all equipped with air-conditioning and free Wi-Fi. There are three superior rooms and a Junior Suite that has a large terrace and street view. A large breakfast is offered daily with a varied selection of local and international goods. For fresh snacks, a quick drink or some ice-cream, guests can use the self-service 24/7 Open Bar. Around the hotel, guests can find some of the best gastronomical offerings in the city, including lively tapas bars, a-la-carte restaurants and lovely lunch spots. For meetings, there are 2 meeting rooms with capacity for up to 100 people. Coffee breaks and snacks can be arranged by NH Barcelona Eixample staff.

hotelbeds:4849.description: This city hotel is located in Barcelona's leisure area just a few minutes' walking distance from the heart of the entertainment. Guests will find lively bars, restaurants and a vivid nightlife scene within easy access of the hotel, while numerous shopping opportunities and cultural attractions can be found close by. The nearest metro station is just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from the hotel. The hotel welcomes guests with comfortable surroundings, warm hospitality and friendly service. The guest rooms offer comfort and convenience and a relaxing ambience in which to unwind and enjoy restful slumber. Guests are invited to sample the culinary delights the breakfast buffet has to offer, setting them up for a long day's sightseeing.

hotelbeds:7993.description: The NH Barcelona Stadium, formerly NH Rallye, offers contemporary comfort in Barcelona's Les Corts district. A short walk from the FC Barcelona stadium and museum, El Corte Inglés, and L'illa Diagonal shopping mall, it also boasts easy access to the Les Corts metro station for city center connections. Each of the 106 modern guest rooms features air-conditioning, Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Some rooms also include a spacious sitting area and tea/coffee making facilities. Start your day with the hotel's delightful breakfast buffet, with made-to-order hot meals and early-bird options available upon request. For lunch and dinner, enjoy authentic Italian cuisine at Ristorante Don Giovanni by renowned chef Andrea Tumbarello, featuring top-quality seasonal products. Or, relax with an aperitif and snacks at the adjacent Gastrobar. The hotel's friendly staff is also happy to recommend excellent local restaurants. For events, the NH Barcelona Stadium offers seven meeting rooms, accommodating up to 250 guests. With advance notice, the dedicated events team can assist with menu planning, equipment, and other services.

hotelbeds:120538.description: This hotel is situated in close proximity to Bogatell beach, in the quiet neighbourhood of Poblenou. The establishment is around 5 kms from the centre of Barcelona and offers easy access to Ronda del Litoral. Built in 2009, this city and business hotel is ideal for guests looking for a quiet location for work or leisure. The modern rooms are all abundant in natural light and come equipped with high-speed Internet access and an en-suite bathroom. Leisure options offered in the establishment include a gym, a sauna and a steam room. Guests can also treat themselves to a massage, which is available upon request.

hotelbeds:7740.description: Be sure to enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool and a fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a ballroom. Enjoy Mediterranean cuisine at Dia Nit, one of the hotel's many dining establishments, which include 2 restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe. Unwind at the end of the day with a drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Barcelona? This hotel has 21743 square feet (2020 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 368 guestrooms featuring espresso makers and plasma televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. hotelbeds:152495.description: This modern and comfortable hotel is located on bustling Gran Via Avenue, close to Plaza España and the FIRA de Barcelona Congress Centre. Conveniently situated near various public transport links, the hotel is just a two-minute walk from the tourist bus line, Aerobus, and a subway station. Attractions such as the Magic Fountain of Montjuic and Palau Sant Jordi are also nearby. This stylish establishment offers a range of spacious rooms ideal for families, groups of friends, and business travelers seeking comfort and a prime location. Accommodation options range from double to quadruple rooms, all fully equipped for a comfortable stay. Guests will appreciate the extensive onsite facilities and services, including high-speed Wi-Fi and private parking. Please note: Special conditions and supplements may apply when booking more than five rooms. A €150 damage deposit is required upon check-in for apartments and family rooms.

address.line: Gran Vía de les Corts Catalanes, 327

hotelbeds:161829.description: This hotel is located in the most artistic stretch of the Ramblas, across from Plaça del Teatre. The hotel occupies two historic buildings located where Barcelona's medieval wall used to be. Designed with modern, youthful and minimalistic style, this is the perfect hotel for visiting Barcelona. A lot of Barcelona's sights are within a few minutes' walk, such as the Gothic Quarter, the cathedral, Plaza de San Jaime, the old Jewish quarter and the shopping areas around the Boquería market.

hotelbeds:449.description: This charming city hotel boasts a superb location in the gothic district in the heart of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy access of a host of cultural and historical attractions including the Sagrada Familia, the Christopher Columbus Statue and the Picasso museum. The airport is conveniently located just a 20 minutes' drive from the hotel. The hotel enjoys a sleek, contemporary style which exudes a calming air of peace and tranquillity. The design of the hotel is inspired by nautical influences featuring soothing tones of blue which complements the neutral decor, and wooden elements. The guest rooms are beautifully designed to feature peaceful neutral hues with azure accents. Guests will appreciate the hotel's array of facilities and services which have been designed with their comfort and convenience in mind.

hotelbeds:4852.description: This hotel is located in close proximity to the centre of Barcelona. Guests will find themselves within easy access of the beautiful Sagrada Familia cathedral and Gaudi Avenue. The hotel is situated within easy access of a host of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel lies just a 2 minutes' walking distance away from the metro station. This modern hotel greets guests with style and charm. The guest rooms are sumptuously designed, combining chic city style with traditional elegance. The hotel affords guests a range of excellent facilities, ensuring a truly enjoyable stay and a memorable city break.
